description: This script lists pre-installed Android apps with sharedUserId in their AndroidManifest.xml files, extracting shared UID info, locating APK files, and outputting app details.

classes.name: AppInfo
classes.description: Named tuple storing app name, shared UID, installed path, and source path.

methods.name: load_module_paths
methods.description: Loads module source paths from a JSON file.

methods.name: find_shared_uid
methods.description: Extracts sharedUserId values from an AndroidManifest.xml file.

methods.name: find_file
methods.description: Locates the APK or JAR file for a given app within the product output directory.

methods.name: collect_apps_with_shared_uid
methods.description: Collects apps with shared UID from the build output, unpacking APKs if necessary.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function parsing arguments, loading module paths, collecting apps, and writing output.
